actions.summary: Board policy encouraging classroom AI with guardrails: an AI Review Committee must approve every tool, students and staff must acknowledge AI use, AI may not substitute for effort or replace human judgment, and prompts/outputs are treated as public records.

actions.authority: school board (draft; adoption targeted for the start of 2026-27)
actions.summary: Draft AI policy centred on ethics, access and 'humans at the center of learning'; students 13+ and staff may use Gemini, Canva and Adobe Express, staff-only NotebookLM, MagicSchool and Khanmigo Teacher. Board members asked for grade-band specifics before adopting.
actions.notes: Lifecycle proposed, so it does not count toward the state's leaning until adopted. Flip to adopted with the vote date when the board acts. Enrollment figure is approximate.
